A '''compressed energy crystal''', also called '''compressed crystals '''and abbreviated '''CEC''', was a type of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]]. CECs were also the central component in [[Ves Volette]]'s [[light sculpture]]s. Removing the crystal from a sculpture would result in the collapse of the gaseous light within, permanently destroying it. 

Certain compressed crystals, when used in lightsabers, caused the energy blade to take on a peculiar "pulsating" appearance with a thinner core. Lightsaber blades created by compressed crystals appeared to be more precise than normal blades.

Compressed energy crystals included but were not limited to [[Luxum]], [[Ilum crystal/Legends|Ilum]] and [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]], and [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]].<ref name="CNII:SOS">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

[[Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] considered using a crystal from one of Volette's light sculptures to construct a new lightsaber since appropriate crystals were nearly impossible to find due to the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]]'s control of the remaining supply. However Jax's companion [[Dejah Duare]], Volette's former partner, vehemently opposed the idea as the sculptures were now irreplaceable after the artist's [[death]]. The issue was resolved when Jax was able to confiscate a lightsaber from [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]].<ref name="CNII:SOS" />
